claims.explanation: NSC-663284 is a redox-cycling quinolinedione that inhibits Cdc25 phosphatases and generates ROS, causing cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis. Selectivity is likely driven by dependence on Cdc25 (high CDC25A/B/C expression) and by MAPK pathway activation (BRAF/NF1 mutations) that increases Cdc25 expression and proliferation, while high anti-apoptotic BIRC5/BCL2 may protect. Virtual-cell data showing oxidative-stress and mitotic gene responses support these mechanisms.

Direct drug target; high expression increases dependence on Cdc25A for CDK activation.

Direct drug target; Cdc25 family inhibition blocks mitotic CDK activation.
Observed enrichment (4 sensitive vs 2 resistant); NF1 loss activates RAS/MAPK signaling.

Survivin is anti-apoptotic; NO downregulates survivin and Cdc25 inhibitors enhance apoptosis.

Virtual-cell response downregulates AURKA; high baseline may indicate mitotic dependence.
Virtual-cell response downregulates PLK1; high baseline may indicate mitotic dependence.
Virtual-cell response downregulates TOP2A; high baseline may indicate proliferation dependence.
